name: Scavenger Survivors
description:
About This Game

Love chaotic physics and horde survival?

Add Scavenger Survivors to your Wishlist now to get notified when the playtests start and the demo goes live!

SCAVENGE. SURVIVE. REPEAT (IF YOU LIVE).

Welcome to the future, Scavenger. In the remains of the old world, salvage is currency, and currency is life. You and your crew are professional scavengers, and your home is the RIG - a moving, heavily armored fortress. Your job is simple: drive into AI infested zones, jump off the vehicle to loot anything that isn’t welded down, and drag it back to cargo.

The catch? The wasteland is crawling with thousands of ravenous mutants, loot is a physics-based nightmare to carry, and your friends are terrible drivers.

BRING YOUR CREW FOR FREE WITH STEAM REMOTE PLAY!

We believe co-op games are meant to be played together, which is why Scavenger Survivors features full STEAM REMOTE PLAY support.

Only one person in your group needs to buy the full copy of the game. They can host a lobby, and up to three friends can join on Steam and play for free. No "purchase barriers," no excuses - just pure, unadulterated co-op chaos.

LOOTING IS A TEAM SPORT (WITH RAGDOLLS).

Scavenging in the wastes isn't as simple as clicking an inventory slot. Valuables like heavy cores, industrial generators, and safes have real physical mass. You have to physically attach a towing cable and drag them back to the RIG. Finished looting? the driver can drag you with the tether across the map!

SURVIVE ENDLESS WASTELAND HORDES.

Wasteland mutants don't attack in groups of five—they attack in thousands. While your ground team is struggling to drag salvage back, the RIG's defensive weapons are your shield.

Level up during runs by vacuuming up experience brains dropped by enemies. Every level allows you to choose roguelite power-ups and weapon upgrades.

EXTRACT OR BECOME SCRAP

Every run is a high-stakes gamble. The longer you stay in a zone, the more valuable the scrap becomes, but the faster the mutant horde grows and adapts.

Join the Scavenger Survivors Discord to recruit your crew, vote on upcoming RIG upgrades, and sign up for our upcoming playtests!

Wishlist Scavenger Survivors now and help a small indie team build the ultimate co-op roadtrip!
short_desc: The machines already won. Now, you scavenge! In this 1-4 player top-down roguelite/survivors hybrid, play as fat scavengers hauling loot from the ruins of the world. Grab and throw anything that isn't bolted down, cram it into your armored RIG, and survive the robot swarm until extraction.
